sectors.trend: AI monetization accelerating: OpenAI $1B ad revenue, Apple CEO transition centered on AI, Nvidia $12.9B catalyst, Caterpillar re-rated as AI infrastructure play, Google $12B AI bet, Alibaba chairman buying shares post AI funding
sectors.implications: AI capex cycle remains dominant but valuations stretched; rotation risk if capex slows. Hardware (Nvidia, Marvell, Broadcom) outperforming software. Data center power demand driving energy and industrial names.

sectors.trend: Oil extends advance on US-Iran strikes; Asian bonds pressured; gold/silver decline on rate-hike expectations; Australia shale gas targeting AI data centers; UK energy spike drives inflation
sectors.implications: Geopolitical premium in oil supports E&P but raises input costs globally. Gold's safe-haven bid overridden by real-yield expectations. Energy transition (hydro, gas) gaining policy tailwinds.

sectors.trend: Australia housing cracks stress private credit; US leveraged ETF boom cooling; Morgan Stanley positive despite bad debt data; hedge fund disclosure delayed by SEC/CFTC
sectors.implications: Private credit vulnerability in housing-linked exposures is a systemic risk signal. Cooling leveraged ETF flows suggest retail risk appetite moderating. Bank earnings resilient but watch NIM compression.

sectors.trend: UK inflation at 2-year high; Affirm blowout quarter with cautious CEO; Victoria's Secret +300% on GLP-1 tailwind; Netflix underperforming S&P 500; estate sales rising
sectors.implications: Consumer bifurcation: premium/health-adjacent spending strong, discretionary under pressure. Inflation eroding real wages in UK. BNPL growth robust but caution signals credit risk building.

sectors.trend: Corporate capex surging on profit growth; 10Y yield near 3%; Ares $3.8B logistics fund; Bessent pushing rate hikes; Honda-Nissan software alliance
sectors.implications: Japan reflation trade maturing; yield curve normalization attracting global capital. Industrial consolidation (Honda-Nissan) signals auto sector transformation. Logistics infrastructure investment cycle underway.

sectors.trend: Bitcoin/Ethereum pressured by rate-hike expectations; Bitmine holds 5.9M ETH; Needham sees further momentum; BDAG falling
sectors.implications: Short-term headwind from real-yield expectations, but institutional accumulation (Bitmine) and structural momentum suggest medium-term resilience. Volatility elevated.

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil-driven inflation and rate-hike expectations create headwinds for equities and bonds simultaneously. Geopolitical premium in oil supports energy but pressures consumer and rate-sensitive sectors. Apple CEO transition and Nvidia catalyst provide tech support. Expect 3-5% equity volatility over next 4-6 weeks. Crypto under pressure but institutional accumulation provides floor.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle enters monetization phase (OpenAI $1B ads, Apple AI pivot) supporting tech earnings. Japan reflation and EM strength offer diversification. Housing/credit stress in Australia is a warning but contained. Energy transition + AI power demand creates multi-year industrial tailwind. Inflation likely sticky at 3-3.5% globally, keeping rates elevated through 2027.
